ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended by changing all of the C2-2,
Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map

No. 18-D in the area bound by:

South Cottage Grove Avenue; a line 125.25 feet south of and parallel to East 76" Street;
the alley next east of and parallel to South Cottage Grove Avenue; a line 233.25 feet
south of and parallel to East 76 Street,

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

I Abi bent

Michelle Harris
Alderperson, 8" Ward

Common Address:
7621 S. Cottage Grove Avenue
